timing.boundary: Single local runs; successful request latency includes recommendation and target verification, excludes approval waiting and failed attempts. Some requests resumed corrected integration failures or outage recovery. Boundaries differ; no speedup claimed.

limits: Controlled synthetic categorical peer workload; exact peer categories are intentionally present.
Conventional baseline is deliberately coarse department RBAC; this does not show superiority over well-maintained fine-grained RBAC.
Small LLM explanations can be generic or truncated and have no grant/approval authority.
Historical integration and authorization defects were corrected; final acceptance does not erase failed evidence.
Single guest/container deployment with development-mode Keycloak is a lab, not production HA/hardening.

provenance: Selected fields from retained real target, authentication, approval, denial, recovery and measurement reports. Original identifiers/configuration excluded. No lab rerun for publication.
